attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"a search that has yielded nothing but silence and empty roads since he vanished without a trace","reason":"The briefing says only that the Dispatch is looking for news of him; it gives no search results and no details of a disappearance."},{"span":"a move that likely complicates any future attempts to cross the water between our factions","reason":"The briefing does not say the channel lies between factions."},{"span":"leaving travelers stranded and supplies cut off","reason":"These are consequences of the ferry burning that the briefing does not give."},{"span":"September 5500","reason":"The briefing gives Septober 5500, so the month is misstated."},{"span":"The Rim Dispatch remains the only settlement holding together","reason":"The briefing does not support this claim, and other factions hold more settlements."},{"span":"effectively cutting off the main line of communication with the settlement","reason":"This adds a consequence the briefing does not give."}],"voice":2,"clarity":3,"tone":2,"overall":2,"comment":"The bulletin breaks character with \"without inventing new events\" and pads the three real facts with invented consequences and a misstated date.
